column1: # Per-task sandbox resources from the 2026-10-08/09 profiling (prof/analysis*). Excluded tasks: excluded_tasks.tsv.
# vcpus: 4 for tasks flagged as CPU-heavy at 2 vCPU (verifier timeout, verifier > 600 s, or >50% of periods throttled
#   with verifier > 300 s or mean tool call > 10 s), else 2. memory_gib: ceil(max memory.peak over attempts, incl. page
#   cache) + 1, from the 8 GiB pass or, for tasks that OOMed there, the 16 GiB rerun; 8 if no profile data. storage_gib: 20.
